rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for passing through a place, opening, passage, area, or process.

example.english: We got through the tunnel and arrived.
example.traditional: 我哋經過條隧道就到喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 zau6 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for physically going through an interior, opening, or obstacle.

example.english: We’ll get there once we go through.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cyun1 gwo3 heoi3 zau6 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this range construction when something extends or progresses from one point or time to another, including the interval.

example.english: We were in meetings through the day.
example.traditional: 由朝早到夜晚，我哋都喺度開會。
example.jyutping: jau4 ziu1 zou2 dou3 je6 maan5 ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai2 dou6 hoi1 wui6

rows.note: Use this for continuing from the beginning all the way to the end, especially for an activity or process.

example.english: I watched the whole movie through.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 tai2 saai3 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use this when someone or something passes an obstacle or is approved to proceed to the next stage.

example.english: The application finally got through the approval process.
example.traditional: 份申請終於通過審批喇。
example.jyutping: fan6 san1 cing2 zung1 jyu1 tung1 gwo3 sam2 pai1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for achieving something via an intermediary, channel, or method rather than by physical movement.

example.english: I found a job through a friend's introduction.
example.traditional: 我透過朋友介紹搵到份工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau3 gwo3 pang4 jau5 gaai3 siu6 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a telephone call is connected through to a person or line.

example.english: Please put me through to Mr Chan.
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 zip3 tung1 can4 saang1 tiu4 sin3

rows.note: Use this when the object has been completely consumed or used up.

example.english: We got through all the coupons.
example.jyutping: di1 gyun3 bei2 ngo5 dei6 jung6 saai3 laa3
